digest:
Voice Channel itself has no new implementation progress in this update.

Recent work focused on your personal planning data. The Grok bridge was hardened against Google Drive filename and rename conflicts, then reconciled through July 17. Your captured logs are useful and conservatively show 15 hours of TransitionState work and 1 hour on Iran, though they are not precise timesheets or automatically reflected in Attention Manager.

This week’s TransitionState plan centered on a secure self-service demo and outreach loop. Those main outcomes are not yet evidenced as complete. The immediate planning issue is overcommitment: 69 planned project hours, seven tasks in progress, and only about 15 hours completed by Friday afternoon.

For Voice Channel, the next objective remains unchanged: verify the Rocket.Chat matter, build a minimal history reader and digest generator, then add simple text-to-speech narration with confirmation-gated replies.
